A plan a weaker model will execute without you: make every decision, write as little as possible
Plan, then implement, under two authorities: technical direction is yours and logged, functional and operational direction is the user's and asked; the plan is the spec

checks.name: plan does not narrate earlier versions

program.def:
def card(work):
    decisions = [{'choice': 'use libass', 'kind': 'technical', 'logged': True}, {'choice': 'retain uploads 30 days', 'kind': 'operational', 'asked_user': False}]
    must_ask = [d['choice'] for d in decisions if d['kind'] in ('functional', 'operational') and (not d.get('asked_user'))]
    plan_text = 'Plan v3\n## Decisions\n- libass over drawtext: Arabic shaping'
    mentions_old = bool(re.search('\\bv[12]\\b|previous version', plan_text.split('## Decisions')[0]))
    save(work, 'authority.json', {'must_ask': must_ask})
    return [eq('operational choice must be asked', must_ask, ['retain uploads 30 days']), truth('plan does not narrate earlier versions', not mentions_old)]

title: Reasoning verifier: a traceability matrix from the original conditions to the conclusion, with each assumption classed given, verified, deduced, invented or unknown
Reason, don't recite: inherited content describes what is and does not justify itself, so re-derive decisions coasting on precedent
Brainstorm only as much as needed: minimal, compact or full triage, a five-line decision capsule, and a cheap context preflight before questions

program.def:
def card(work):
    r = [triage_brainstorm(dict(public_interface=False, persistence=False, cross_cutting=False, material_default=False)), triage_brainstorm(dict(public_interface=False, persistence=False, cross_cutting=False, material_default=True)), triage_brainstorm(dict(public_interface=True, persistence=False, cross_cutting=False, material_default=False))]
    capsule = ['outcome', 'convention', 'decision', 'check', 'risk']
    preflight_docs = [f for f in ['README.md', 'LICENSE', 'docs/design.md'] if f not in ('README.md', 'LICENSE')]
    save(work, 'triage.json', {'modes': r, 'capsule': capsule})
    return [eq('triage', r, ['minimal', 'compact', 'full']), eq('five-line capsule', len(capsule), 5), eq('README/LICENSE do not count', preflight_docs, ['docs/design.md'])]

title: Elicit the decisions an intent turns on: show the whole map first, ask only what cannot be derived, treat input as material not truth
Choose agent execution rails: one owner per slot (spec, execution discipline, review, code security, setup governance)
Evaluate a skill like a function under test: a blind fresh agent per case, a separate judge applying the bar, and a ratchet that never accepts a lower score

program.def:
def card(work):
    case = {'input': 'make a 10 s Arabic intro', 'bar': {'must': ['RTL', '10 s'], 'smells': ['lorem']}}
    artifact = 'RTL kinetic title, duration 10 s'
    judge = all((m in artifact for m in case['bar']['must'])) and (not any((s in artifact for s in case['bar']['smells'])))
    best, acc = ratchet([0.6, 0.7, 0.65, 0.8])
    save(work, 'skill_eval.json', {'judge': judge, 'ratchet': acc})
    return [truth('separate judge applies bar', judge), eq('ratchet never accepts lower', acc, [0.6, 0.7, 0.8]), eq('best', best, 0.8)]

title: Authoring skills and curating the library: is it a skill at all, a description that says when not what, and keep/fix/cut by measured delta
Turn a repeated correction into a rule in the right place: context file, skill, path rule, hook or test

def card(work):
    b = dict(correctness=False, every_time=False, scoped_path=False, multi_step=False)
    r = [rule_home(b), rule_home(dict(b, multi_step=True)), rule_home(dict(b, scoped_path=True)), rule_home(dict(b, every_time=True)), rule_home(dict(b, correctness=True))]
    save(work, 'rule_homes.json', r)
    return [eq('homes', r, ['context file', 'skill', 'path rule', 'hook', 'test'])]
